metadata.question: Did smoke plumes from the Itcha Lake fire spread south into the US Pacific Northwest on September 2, 2025?

- Dataset: COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/AER_AI (fallback to COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/AER_AI)
- Date: 2025-09-02 (UTC day)
- Locations: (a) Source near Itcha Lake, BC (circle ~60 km radius); (b) Corridor from source into Washington (buffered line ~100 km); (c) US Pacific Northwest (Washington + Oregon from TIGER states).

2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?).
- Use S5P quality mask: qa_value >= 0.5. AAI is robust to some cloud but qa filter removes low-quality retrievals. No explicit cloud band available here.

3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3).
- If image collection size is 0 after attempts => C1.
- If any ROI has 0 valid pixels after masking => C2.
- If stats return null/NaN => C3.
- Otherwise: compute AAI stats (mean and fraction of pixels with AAI>1.0). If source, corridor, and PNW all show elevated AAI (thresholds), answer A; else B.

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    var dateStart = '2025-09-02';
    var dateEnd = '2025-09-03';

    // Approximate Itcha Lake area (central British Columbia)
    var itchaPt = ee.Geometry.Point([-124.8, 52.7]);
    var srcRegion = itchaPt.buffer(60000); // ~60 km

    // Corridor: buffered line from Itcha area to central Washington
    var waCenter = ee.Geometry.Point([-120.5, 47.5]);
    var corridor = ee.Geometry.LineString([itchaPt.coordinates(), waCenter.coordinates()]).buffer(100000); // ~100 km

    // US PNW: Washington + Oregon
    var states = ee.FeatureCollection('TIGER/2018/States');
    var pnw = states.filter(ee.Filter.inList('NAME', ['Washington', 'Oregon'])).geometry();

    // Union area for filtering S5P swaths
    var bigROI = srcRegion.union(corridor).union(pnw);

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    function prepareS5p(img) {
      // Mask low-quality retrievals
      var qaMask = img.select('qa_value').gte(0.5);
      return img.updateMask(qaMask).select('absorbing_aerosol_index');
    }

    async function evaluate(obj) {
      return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        obj.evaluate((res, err) => {
          if (err) reject(err);
          else resolve(res);
        });
      });
    }

    var colOffl = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/AER_AI')
      .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
      .filterBounds(bigROI)
      .map(prepareS5p);

    var offlSize = await evaluate(colOffl.size());
    var usingNRT = false;
    var col = colOffl;

    if (!offlSize || offlSize === 0) {
      var colNRT = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/NRTI/AER_AI')
        .filterDate(dateStart, dateEnd)
        .filterBounds(bigROI)
        .map(prepareS5p);
      var nrtSize = await evaluate(colNRT.size());
      if (!nrtSize || nrtSize === 0) {
        console.log(`S5P OFFL images: 0`);
        console.log(`S5P NRTI images: 0`);
        console.log('C1');
        return;
      } else {
        usingNRT = true;
        col = colNRT;
        console.log(`S5P OFFL images: 0`);
        console.log(`S5P NRTI images: ${nrtSize}`);
      }
    } else {
      console.log(`S5P OFFL images: ${offlSize}`);
    }

    // Composite of the day
    var aiImg = col.mean().rename('AAI'); // absorbing aerosol index composite
    var aiGT1 = aiImg.gt(1.0).rename('GT1');

    async function getStats(region) {
      // Combined reducer for mean, count, min, max on AAI
      var dict1 = aiImg.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true})
                .combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.minMax(), sharedInputs: true}),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });
      var dict2 = aiGT1.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: region,
        scale: 5000,
        maxPixels: 1e9
      });

      var d1 = await evaluate(dict1);
      var d2 = await evaluate(dict2);

      var mean = d1 ? d1.AAI_mean : null;
      var count = d1 ? d1.AAI_count : null;
      var minv = d1 ? d1.AAI_min : null;
      var maxv = d1 ? d1.AAI_max : null;
      var gt1 = d2 ? d2.GT1_sum : null;

      return {
        mean: mean,
        count: count,
        min: minv,
        max: maxv,
        gt1: gt1,
        pct_gt1: (count && gt1 != null && count > 0) ? (gt1 / count) : null
      };
    }

    // 3. Processing & Validation
    var sStats = await getStats(srcRegion);
    var cStats = await getStats(corridor);
    var pStats = await getStats(pnw);

    function isInvalid(val) {
      return val === null || val === undefined || (typeof val === 'number' && !isFinite(val));
    }

    // Check C2 (no valid pixels after QA masking)
    if (!sStats.count || sStats.count === 0 || !cStats.count || cStats.count === 0 || !pStats.count || pStats.count === 0) {
      console.log(`Source valid px: ${sStats.count || 0}`);
      console.log(`Corridor valid px: ${cStats.count || 0}`);
      console.log(`PNW valid px: ${pStats.count || 0}`);
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }

    // Check C3 (calculation failure)
    if (isInvalid(sStats.mean) || isInvalid(cStats.mean) || isInvalid(pStats.mean) ||
        isInvalid(sStats.pct_gt1) || isInvalid(cStats.pct_gt1) || isInvalid(pStats.pct_gt1)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    // Print concise evidence
    function fmt(n, d=2) { return (n === null || n === undefined) ? 'null' : Number(n).toFixed(d); }
    function pct(n) { return (n === null || n === undefined) ? 'null' : (Number(n)*100).toFixed(1) + '%'; }

    console.log(`Source AAI: px=${sStats.count}, mean=${fmt(sStats.mean)}, >1.0=${pct(sStats.pct_gt1)}`);
    console.log(`Corridor AAI: px=${cStats.count}, mean=${fmt(cStats.mean)}, >1.0=${pct(cStats.pct_gt1)}`);
    console.log(`PNW (WA+OR) AAI: px=${pStats.count}, mean=${fmt(pStats.mean)}, >1.0=${pct(pStats.pct_gt1)}`);

    // 4. Decision logic
    // Thresholds tuned for S5P AAI indicating smoke presence and continuity southward.
    var sourceOK = (sStats.count > 10) && (sStats.mean > 0.6 || sStats.pct_gt1 >= 0.10);
    var corrOK   = (cStats.count > 10) && (cStats.mean > 0.4 || cStats.pct_gt1 >= 0.05);
    var pnwOK    = (pStats.count > 10) && (pStats.mean > 0.3 || pStats.pct_gt1 >= 0.03);

    console.log(`Flags: sourceOK=${sourceOK}, corridorOK=${corrOK}, pnwOK=${pnwOK}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    if (sourceOK && corrOK && pnwOK) {
      console.log('A');
    } else {
      console.log('B');
    }

  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
